Pair a faster executor model with a higher-intelligence advisor model that provides strategic guidance mid-generation, so long-horizon agentic workloads get close to advisor-solo quality while the bulk of token generation happens at executor-model rates. Include the beta header advisor-tool-2026-03-01 in your requests.

items.snippet: We've launched structured outputs in beta, providing guaranteed schema conformance for Claude's responses. items.title: Anthropic release notes: September 2, 2025
items.snippet: We've launched v2 of the Code Execution Tool in beta, replacing the original Python-only tool with Bash command execution and direct file manipulation capabilities, including writing code in other languages.

items.title: Anthropic release notes: August 19, 2025
items.snippet: Request IDs are now included directly in error response bodies alongside the existing request-id header. Learn more in Error shapes.

items.title: Anthropic release notes: June 11, 2025
items.snippet: We've launched fine-grained tool streaming in beta, a feature that enables Claude to stream tool use parameters without buffering / JSON validation. To enable fine-grained tool streaming, use the beta header fine-grained-tool-streaming-2025-05-14.

items.title: Anthropic release notes: September 10th, 2024
